## Session topics & takeaways

This session covers:

1. Predictive (waterfall), iterative, incremental, adaptive, hybrid
2. When requirements uncertainty chooses the approach for you
3. Stacey matrix; requirements volatility; regulatory constraints
4. Data projects vs software projects vs platform projects
3. Phase gates vs sprints vs continuous flow
